name: windows-troubleshoot

plugins.name: windows-troubleshoot
plugins.description: Diagnose Windows 10/11 and Windows Server problems with Microsoft TSS: map a symptom to the right TSS scenario and exact command, run a read-only health triage, and turn a collected TSS / MS_DATA zip into plain-English findings.
